scripts.dev: node scripts/summary.js && concurrently -n "BE,FE,MCP,MAIL" -c "green,blue,yellow,magenta" "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w mcp-server" "npx maildev --smtp 1025 --web 1081"
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:sync && npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run prisma:generate -w mcp-server
scripts.db:init: npm run db:sync && cd apps/backend && rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema ./prisma/schema.prisma --script > ./prisma/schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute edustack_db --local --file=./prisma/schema.sql
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:sync && cd apps/backend && npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema ./prisma/schema.prisma --script > ./prisma/schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute edustack_db --remote --file=./prisma/schema.sql
scripts.db:studio: npm run db:sync && npm run prisma studio -w backend
